title: Lee Bounds with a Heavy-Tailed Treated Arm and a Shrinking Selection Gap
banked_reason: D0.5.G tier=subfield < floor=field; paper_score_ceiling 6.7 < 7.4; not salvageable within scope. Decision and math PASS; independent validity audit confirms sound-but-below-field.
gap_reasons: The delivered frontier matches risk and honest interval-length orders over the declared class, including equality and the critical-exponent window; no stale claim of an unresolved matched result remains. Its scope requires externally supplied gap bands, tail exponents and outcome scale, and the nonmonotonicity concerns distinct announced experiments rather than exact finite-sample minimax monotonicity. The bounded-outcome assumptions in [Semenova](https://arxiv.org/html/2008.12720v4) and the fixed-level hypotheses in [Bartl–Eckstein](https://arxiv.org/html/2405.00357v2) do not supply this joint frontier. The practical shortfall is substantial: the certified grid has (10^10 n^4+1)^2 points, and the radius 5120 rho forces the interval to equal [-1,8] for every sample whenever n≤323634. These implementation and calibration limitations, together with the narrow public-input experiment and applications serving only as motivation, constrain the projected paper score to 6.7 despite the completed rate theorem. The inaccessible Jureckova–Koenker–Welsh and Deheuvels–Mason–Shorack theorem texts remain source-verification items, while the unpublished internal comparator supplies background rather than independent novelty evidence. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.7 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived matching minimax risk and finite-sample honest connected-length orders over the original-record class, with finite computation and legal lower pairs; the decision and mathematical panels passed after source attestation. The final general review graded the delivered package subfield (score 6.7), below the fixed field floor, because of narrow public inputs and an impractical grid and interval radius. The independent terminal audit confirmed downgrade; formalization was not launched, and inaccessible comparator theorem texts remain disclosed source-verification limitations.
tldr: A deliberately stylized Lee benchmark asks how much precision is attainable when treatment trims the only heavy selected-outcome law and the selection gap lies in an announced shrinking band. The treated law is unknown within a public two-sided shifted-Pareto density envelope, and the unknown selected-control law has a public second-moment bound. The contribution is the complete joint original-record minimax absolute-risk and exactly finite-sample honest connected-length frontier in sample size, public gap band and tail exponent, including announced equality and the joint critical-exponent window. An evaluated positive rate, common absolute constants, a total computable estimator and interval, and same-class converses for arbitrary randomized procedures are the deliverables. The public tail class is a conditional stress benchmark; neither empirical tail validity nor calibration for a generic Lee application is asserted.
gap: Lee identifies sharp trimming, and fixed-level expected-shortfall and estimated-trimming theory supply essential ingredients. The banked two-heavy-arm frontier uses an untrimmed-heavy-control obstruction excluded here. Donoho--Liu supplies a general testing framework, not an evaluated Lee-specific modulus with verified composite-test hypotheses. The primary intermediate-trim results audited here require interior trimming or divergent deterministic trim counts and do not deliver the announced-band original-record minimax and finite-sample length criteria.
fill: Evaluate the retained-density and same-band selection channels together and match them with an original-record construction and exact finite-sample endpoint coverage. Common constants must cover the bounded-count and critical-exponent regimes and the certified numerical implementation. The field-tier target is this joint frontier; ordinary trimming, functional testing and robust means remain foundations. The contribution is conditional on the stated public class and its disclosed robustness boundary.
